author: KEXP
description: With a soulful and groove-heavy self-titled debut, Kucha, Zeimani, and BG honor their deep musical roots and forge a path of their own. Live on KEXP, The Womack Sisters deliver powerful vocals and jaw-dropping harmonies with a performance of "If I Let You" and more.
title: The Womack Sisters performs "If I Let You" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
